title: Yoisaki Kanade — This Spring, With You...〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, a piano won't work here...
It needs something stronger...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I can test out a few more sounds. Once this part's done...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, dinner's ready!
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you as always, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just doing my job. Please, while everything's still warm.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay... Oh, is that a branch from a cherry tree in that bottle?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it is. I came across it by a park on my way over here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Some children were playing catch and they accidentally broke this branch off.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It even has buds that look like they're ready to bloom...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Exactly. That's why it seemed like such a shame to just leave it be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I knew that Ms. Mochizuki's an incredibly kind person, but I didn't realize that even extended to animals and plants.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this branch is so thin. Do you think it'll still bloom like this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, about that. I did some research and read that if you put it in water with some fertilizer mixed in, it'll still have a chance to bloom.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My mother and I do some gardening at home, so we have plenty of fertilizer. I went back to get some to try this method out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Housework, cooking and gardening?
You must be superwoman.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we just grow some herbs in small planters, so it's really nothing special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And please excuse me. I've been talking your ear off, haven't I...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I'm not much of a talker, and I like hearing about what you do, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Cherry blossoms, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When I was little, mom, dad and I went to see them together. I only remember that they were really beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I wish we could see them again...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, Ms. Mochizuki?
If this branch does end up blooming, would you mind showing me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, of course!
I'll do my best to make sure it does!
One week later

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, I brought it over as promised!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, they really bloomed...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but one of the buds just wouldn't open up. Luckily, all the other ones turned into cherry blossoms just fine!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I never knew that they could still bloom like this even after what happened to it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, would it be okay if I borrowed this for a little while? There's someone I'd like to show this to...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You can have it, Ms. Yoisaki. My original plan was to place it somewhere in your room once it managed to bloom.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course. I even brought you some extra fertilizer water to make sure it stays healthy for as long as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As long as you keep giving it that, you should be able to enjoy it for a good while longer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Ms. Mochizuki...
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because you had such a gentle look in your eyes just now when you saw this. It felt like it meant much more to you then it did to me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I apologize if I'm assuming too much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I promise to take good care of it.
The next day
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, I brought you a change of clothes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (He's sleeping again. To be fair, it is nice and warm out today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's also something I want to show you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here, some cherry blossoms.
A very good friend of mine gave them to me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope you still remember...
That time we went to see them with mom...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe someday, we can go again together...
